Block WebRTC IP Leak Prevent websites and browsers from discovering your real IP and local network addresses via WebRTC STUN Note: Blocking WebRTC STUN prevents IP leaks on leak-test and tracking sites, but may affect browser-based real-time video/voice calls (e.g. web Discord, Google Meet).
